subject: Billing consolidation & invoice delivery for renewal and capacity add-on
messages:
From: Marta Silva <marta.silva@cordisai.com>

Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@cordisai.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Nov 2028 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Billing consolidation & invoice delivery for renewal

Hi Ben,

We're finalizing our renewal + capacity add-on with Redwood and want to simplify how invoices are delivered going forward. We plan to submit a single PO that covers the renewal term plus the additional GPU capacity we discussed (details in procurement). Two asks from our side:

- Can Redwood consolidate charges for the renewal and the Q1 expansion onto a single monthly invoice (one invoice for the committed capacity + top-up usage) sent to accounts-payable@cordisai.com?
- What remit address / tax documentation do you need from us (W-9 / EIN)? We can attach a corporate PO but want to ensure the invoice will route to our AP system without manual intervention.

If you can confirm the preferred PO format and whether Redwood can support Net45 terms on this committed renewal, that will speed our internal approvals.

I can share the PO as soon as you confirm the billing contact and any required fields.

Thanks,
Marta Silva
Head of Procurement, CordisAI
marta.silva@cordisai.com
+1 415-555-0198

(Procurement Team copied)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marta Silva <marta.silva@cordisai.com>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 1 Nov 2028 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Billing consolidation & invoice delivery for renewal

Hi Marta — thanks for the note and for lining this up. We can support a consolidated invoice flow for the renewal + capacity add-on. A few details / proposals:

- Invoicing: We can issue a single monthly invoice that references one PO number for the renewal + expansion line items. That invoice will include line-level SKUs and quantities so your AP parser can code charges to the right cost centers.
- Terms: For a committed renewal with the capacity add-on, we can offer Net45. If you need Net60 that will require a short approval from our finance director — Net45 should be fine for DW-4521.
- Required fields: please include PO number, legal entity name, remit address, and tax ID (EIN). If you can include your internal cost center code on the PO (e.g., 4-OPS-LLM) we will surface that on the invoice.

Next steps: Ive attached a draft Master Billing Addendum (MasterBillingAddendum_v3.pdf) that documents the consolidated invoice approach and shows sample invoice layout. Grace (billing) and Vanessa (AM) are on the thread to pick this up once we receive the official PO. Rishi will help map SKU/usage lines if your PO lists specific SKUs.

If you can send the PO and W-9/EIN confirmation, well turn around a draft invoice for review within 48 business hours.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 206-555-0134

Hi Marta — welcome, and thanks Ben. A couple operational notes from billing:

1) We will need either a completed W-9 (for US entities) or equivalent tax form if CordisAI invoices under a different entity. Please send the PDF or confirm EIN and legal entity name.
2) For the AP ingestion: include the PO number in the PO reference field and list the cost center on at least one line of the PO. Our accounting system will use the PO#/Remit address combo to route invoices automatically to accounts-payable@cordisai.com.
3) If you want invoices to be split by department code (rather than one combined line), include the cost center next to the corresponding SKU lines. Otherwise we will consolidate at invoice generation and include a single control total.

Attached is a short W-9 request template we use when customers prefer to fill out standard fields. If you prefer to send your corporate W-9 that works too.

Grace O'Connor
Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
